summary: Practise business impact analysis, recovery prioritization, and continuity exercises aligned with ISO 22301. Explore the course and build practical skills.
lede: Business impact analysis and continuity exercise design helps continuity, risk, and service professionals link recovery plans to critical services. Participants map dependencies, assess disruption impacts and recovery priorities, compare recovery options against resource constraints, and design scenario-based exercises that turn observations into improvement actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals accountable for service continuity, operational impact analysis, recovery planning, or disruption exercises. It suits people who need to connect written plans with operational dependencies and decisions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with operational services, risk, incident response, or continuity planning is recommended. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted analysis are introduced at a conceptual awareness level; the course focuses on operational application of business impact analysis and exercise design.
